items.title: Adding Oxlint as new supported tool – September 2026
items.content_html: We're excited to announce support for Oxlint, a fast Rust-based linter for JavaScript and TypeScript from the Oxc project. With this addition, Codacy can now automatically analyze your JavaScript and TypeScript projects for correctness, style, and best-practice issues (among other categories), reporting them directly in your dashboard.

items.title: Support for Shellcheck configuration file - July, 2026
items.content_html: We’ve upgraded how Shellcheck works on Codacy! While you previously had to configure Shellcheck analysis directly through the Codacy UI, you can now manage your settings using a configuration file.

items.title: PHP_CodeSniffer Upgrade and Legacy Package Deprecations – July 2026
items.content_html: We are preparing to upgrade our PHP CodeSniffer tool to the latest version. This update will bring vital performance improvements, better syntax parsing, and support for the latest PHP features.
